data.name: Wanderbound
data.detailed_description:
Lace Up Your Boots and Take to the Trail

Adventure called, and you answered! In your excitement, you arrive at the trailhead with no supplies beyond your backpack. Fortunately, with some perseverance and a bit of luck, you’ll be able to find everything you need along the way.

Discover the World Off Trail

As you wander alongside calm streams, shady forests, and peaceful meadows, you generate your world. No two walks are the same and each playthrough is unique. Will you discover a forgotten castle, weave through a slot canyon, or spot a rare bird? The only way to know what’s out there is to go and see it for yourself. Just keep an eye on your energy, so your hike doesn’t end before the trail does.

Wander Your Way

Where you explore and how you spend your time is up to you. Will you specialize in one area or become a jack-of-all-trades? Will you speed to the trail end or discover all the secrets the land offers? The choice is yours.
  • Rest at a campsite, searching for constellations as you roast a marshmallow over the fire.
  • Cast your line for fish to fuel your hike or dive into the water yourself.
  • Create paintings, sketches, and sculptures inspired by the nature you see.
  • Forage for fresh berries and herbs to eat as they change through the seasons.
  • Spot shapes in the clouds and patterns in the falling leaves.
  • Climb to the mountain peaks and treetops to get a greater view of the wonders around you.
Get ready to wander. Wishlist Wanderbound on Steam to stay updated!

data.short_description: Leave the beaten path and set off into a cozy world that builds itself as you explore it. Create, observe, catch, gather, camp and climb your way through the seasons.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit dual-core processor (verified on Intel Core i3-1315U)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Direct3D 12 capable GPU (feature level 11_0). Intel UHD integrated graphics are sufficient.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required; no controller support. No internet connection needed.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 64-bit quad-core processor
  • Memory: 6144 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated or modern integrated GPU with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: For 1920x1080 at 60 fps with shadows, glow and depth of field.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 Big Sur (Apple Silicon) / macOS 10.15 Sierra (Intel)
  • Processor: Apple Silicon or Intel - universal binary, runs natively on both
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (Apple Silicon integrated, Intel Iris, or AMD discrete)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required; no controller support. No internet connection needed.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or newer
  • Memory: 6144 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated GPU (M1 or newer)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: For 1920x1080 at 60 fps with shadows, glow and depth of field.
